facility.name: Carmenza D Beltran
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - Once a year listed family homes, licensed, and registered child care homes must validate list of subjects: The background check list has not been validated since 05/20/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - Once a year listed family homes, licensed, and registered child care homes must validate list of subjects (26 TAC §745.651(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Three children files observed did not contained a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: Two children files observed did not include the start date, and/or date of admission.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §747.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Posting of CPSC website: The most recent CPSC form was signed and dated July 12, 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Posting of CPSC website (26 TAC §747.3935(c))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: Three children files observed did not contain the required special needs information. Three children files observed were documented on the 2017 admission form, which does not include the required special needs statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: During the inspection the home was found to not have been conducting fire drills as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: During review of record keeping 2 out of 4 records evaluated did not include immunizations as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records: The primary caregiver was unable to provide their personnel record when requested.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records (26 TAC §747.901)

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible: During the inspection I observed clorox cleaning wipes on a counter accessible to children in care.       This was corrected when the primary caregiver moved the wipes further back on the counter, out of the children's reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible (26 TAC §747.3203(13))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During the inspection I observed a caregiver without cleared eligible results caring for 9 children between 20 months and 3 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - Registered Child Care Home: During the inspection the registered home caregiver was providing care for 9 children between the ages of 20 months and 3 years old. The registrant is only permitted to provide care for 6 children before after-school hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - Registered Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1701)

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Keeping Children Safe Poster: The Keeping Children Safe document was not posted at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Keeping Children Safe Poster (26 TAC §747.401(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-License: At the time of the inspection the license was not posted at the operation  in a prominent location viewable by the public.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-License (26 TAC §747.401(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Must Have at Least One 3A-40BC Dry Chemical Fire Extinguisher or Fire Extinguisher Approved by Fire Marshal: The fire extinguisher located in the home is classified as a 1-A;10-B;C. The operation should have a 3A-40BC Dry Chemical Fire Extinguisher or an extinguisher that has been approved by the state or local fire marshal.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Must Have at Least One 3A-40BC Dry Chemical Fire Extinguisher or Fire Extinguisher Approved by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §747.5103)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Discipline: The operation does not have a discipline and guidance policy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Discipline (26 TAC §747.501(5))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Telephone Numbers: The number(s) for law enforcement, fire and/or medical (911), poison control, abuse and neglect hot line and licensing were not listed nor were they posted in a prominent location viewable by parents and the public.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Telephone Numbers (26 TAC §747.401(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operation does not have a written operational policy for the promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Vaccine Preventable Diseases: The home does not have an operational policy on vaccine preventable diseases.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Vaccine Preventable Diseases (26 TAC §747.501(14))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: Two children  in care at the time of the inspection did not have date of admission on file at the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §747.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two children in care at the time of inspection did not have immunizations on file. This was corrected during inspection when the director obtained the current immunizations from the parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: There was no documentation of the fire drill, severe weather/sheltering drill, and/or carbon monoxide detector testing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: There were no training hours available for review for the primary caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Two individual's were observed in the home did not have an active background check. Based on the information obtained, one individual has been employed since 06/2023. The other individual present introduced themselves as a tutor.  Background checks were submitted while Licensing was present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies do not contain policies on the promotion of active play and health checks in the facility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §747.207(1))
